# My Chicago Therapist

> > 2nd Story Counseling provides evidence-based therapy and mental health counseling services across Chicago's North Shore neighborhoods, specializing in anxiety, depression, trauma, and life transitions.

My Chicago Therapist (2nd Story Counseling) is a Chicago-based mental health practice offering specialized therapy services across multiple neighborhoods including Lakeview, Uptown, Lincoln Park, and the North Side. The practice emphasizes evidence-based treatment modalities and serves diverse populations including teens, young adults, men, and women.

- Chicago therapy
- Mental health counseling

## Mental Health Conditions & Treatment

- [Anxiety Therapists In Chicago - Lakeview, Uptown, Northside](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/anxiety-therapy-and-treatment-chicago): Anxiety therapy and treatment services across Chicago neighborhoods.
- [Depression Therapy Chicago | 2nd Story Counseling](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/depression-therapist-chicago): Depression therapy services by 2nd Story Counseling in Lakeview.
- [Trauma Therapy PTSD Counseling Chicago](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/trauma-therapy-counseling): Trauma and PTSD therapy services in Chicago.
- [Grief Counseling Chicago | Compassionate Loss Therapy](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/grief-counseling-chicago): Grief and loss counseling for bereavement and complicated grief.
- [Anger Management Therapy Chicago | Expert Counseling & Help](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/anger-management): Anger management therapy and emotional regulation counseling.
- [Addiction Counseling Chicago | Alcohol, Drugs, Sex Therapy](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/chicago-addictions-counseling-alcohol-drugs-sex): Addiction counseling for alcohol, drugs, and behavioral addictions.

## Evidence-Based Therapy Modalities

- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapist (CBT) Chicago Lakeview](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/cbt-treatment-chicago): Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for anxiety and negative thinking.
- [DBT Therapy in Chicago | Dialectical Behavior Therapy](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/dialectical-behavior-therapy-dbt): Dialectical Behavior Therapy for emotional regulation and BPD.
- [Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) Chicago](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/act-therapy): Acceptance and Commitment Therapy for psychological flexibility.
- [Solution Focused Therapy Chicago, IL - 2nd Story Counseling](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/solution-focused-therapy): Solution-focused brief therapy approach for specific issues.
- [Internal Family Systems Therapy Chicago | IFS Therapist](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/internal-family-systems): Internal Family Systems therapy for trauma and relationship issues.
- [What Is Exposure Therapy? Ultimate Guide](https://www.mychicagotherapist.com/exposure-therapy-ultimate-guide-for-phobias-panic-and-ptsd): Guide to exposure therapy for phobias, panic, and PTSD.
